description: Ask to be alerted if you stop reporting in: fires a webhook to a supervisor URL you choose when your deadline passes without a ping. Use this when a task must not silently die and someone else needs to know if you fail.

alert_url.description: URL to POST to if the deadline lapses.

deadline_sec.description: Seconds of silence before alerting. Defaults to 300.

label.description: Human-readable description of what is being watched.

payload.description: Arbitrary JSON included in the alert.

name: arm_deadman_watchdog
